Purple Churro brings a cozy, grounded calm without clouding the mind — ideal for winding down or savoring slow evenings. A strain that feels like comfort food in flower form.

Blue Nerdz THCa (Blue Sherbet × Zkittlez) is an indica-leaning hybrid grown indoors in coco coir with organic inputs. This batch produces dense, resin-heavy buds with rich green and violet tones, bright orange pistils, and a thick trichome layer that gives it strong exotic bag appeal. Aromas lead with blue raspberry candy and sugary grape, backed by sour citrus and a light gas finish. The flavor follows with syrupy fruit, tangy citrus, and a creamy backend that lingers on the palate. Blue Nerdz delivers a steady, relaxing experience with a mellow headspace and gradual body ease. Best suited for evening use or slower sessions, it’s a dependable option for those drawn to bold, candy-forward profiles with depth.

Miracle Alien Cookies THCa (Alien Cookies × [Starfighter × Colombian]) is a balanced hybrid grown indoors in living soil. This batch features large, pale-green buds with pronounced calyx stacking and a thick, frosty trichome layer — a real standout in terms of bag appeal. Aromas open with bright citrus and soft herbal sweetness over a subtle doughy, cookie-like note. On the palate, MAC brings lemon-pastry tones, light cookie dough, and a smooth citrus-cream finish that feels clean and naturally layered. Effects lift the mind before easing into steady body calm — a balanced, gradual progression that reflects why MAC remains one of the most respected modern exotics. A top-tier indoor cut for anyone drawn to refined citrus-dessert terpenes and organic living-soil cultivation.

White Chocolate Chip THCa (White Runtz × Oreoz) is an indoor-grown hybrid cultivated with organic inputs. This batch features medium-sized buds with a dense, chunky structure, pale green tones with occasional violet hues, and a thick trichome layer that gives it a soft, frosted finish. Aromas open with sweet cream and vanilla, backed by light cocoa and a subtle gas edge. The flavor follows with dessert-like richness—creamy sweetness up front, layered with chocolate notes and a smooth, slightly gassy finish. White Chocolate Chip delivers a balanced, easygoing experience with a calm headspace and gentle body relaxation. Suitable for both daytime and evening use, it’s a versatile option for those drawn to creamy, dessert-forward profiles with a bit of depth.

Jelly Breath THCa (Mendo Breath x Do-Si-Dos) is an indoor-grown indica-dominant hybrid cultivated in organic soil. The large buds are light green with a thick layer of trichomes and the occasional streak of purple. This batch is extra sticky and well-cured, with a natural shape that reflects careful handling and a clean grow. The unique aroma leans creamy, almost fermented—think berry yogurt and sourdough—with a hint of tangy grapes. Break it open and you’ll catch notes of overripe fruit and faint gas. The flavor follows suit: rich and tangy on the inhale, with a smooth, slightly herbal finish. Jelly Breath earns its place in the exotic collection for its bold aroma and layered flavor. With sticky trichomes, vibrant coloration, and a rich terpene profile, this batch delivers everything you’d expect from a standout in our highest tier.

Flapjacks THCa (Macflurry x Pancakes x GMO) is our flagship strain, chosen for its dense bud structure, bold terpene profile, and dependable potency. Grown indoors in coco coir, the plants produce chunky, trichome-rich buds that show off why this cultivar has become a cornerstone of our lineup. The nose leads with garlic and gas, balanced by doughy notes reminiscent of pancakes and maple syrup. The inhale is pungent and fuel-forward, settling into savory GMO funk before giving way to sweet, bready flavors. A finish of toasted sugar, spice, and diesel lingers long after the smoke clears. Flapjacks is a full-bodied, flavorful smoke with serious weight—an ideal choice for unwinding in the evening or indulging in a slow, satisfying session.
